description:
Coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, goose, Cline, Aider...) and agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, smolagents, Mastra, LangGraph) with docs-verified facts.
Use when: the user is choosing a coding agent or agent framework by licence, interface, model support or features.
Do not use for: one harness in depth (get_harness); app builders such as Lovable (list_tools).
Returns: per harness: maker, interface, licence, GitHub stars with date, models, pricing with pricing_checked, features (MCP, subagents, headless, sandboxing) with features_checked, last_checked.
Limits: Filters: kind, interface prefix, open_source, byo_model, mcp, q; limit 1-100, default 25. null means not stated or not verified, never 'no'. Sources per harness via get_harness.
Example: {"kind":"coding agent","open_source":true,"mcp":true}

byo_model.description: true = only harnesses documented to accept your own model/provider.

interface.description: Interface prefix, e.g. CLI, IDE, desktop, SDK.

mcp.description: true = only harnesses with documented MCP support.

open_source.description: true = only open source; false = only not open source.

q.description: Substring match on name, maker or description.

name: list_harnesses
title: List agent harnesses
